name: post-impact-escalation-matrix
purpose: Deterministic impact-zone to system-risk routing for vehicle-assessment. Match the evidenced impact zone(s), then carry each zone's systems_at_risk and required_evidence into the pack, applying the listed escalations. Prose reasoning lives in post-impact-system-checks.md and adas-ev-hv-prompts.md.

escalation_codes.diagnostic_scan: Pre/post diagnostic scan evidence required before affected systems are treated as undamaged.
escalation_codes.strip_inspection: Strip/dismantle evidence required; supplementary findings recorded as a separate evidence stage.
escalation_codes.manufacturer_method: Current OEM/Thatcham method governs; route to manufacturer-methods-evidence.
escalation_codes.adas_calibration: Calibration requirement and completion evidence required (adas-ev-hv-prompts.md).
escalation_codes.hv_competent_person: Stop at risk identification until a competent technician and current manufacturer procedure confirm isolation/make-safe/battery condition.
escalation_codes.srs_procedure: Restraint-system inspection and diagnostic scan under manufacturer procedure.
escalation_codes.salvage_routing: Category-relevant damage; read total-loss-and-salvage-routing.md and route to salvage-categorisation for the category.
escalation_codes.history_check: Identity/marker/mileage facts via vehicle-history-check before reliance.

global_triggers.meaning: SRS deployed or restraint fault until scanned; on side impacts assume deployment, not pre-existing fault.
System evidence: identify the fluid, source and affected system before movement or road test.
Impact evidence until diagnostic results show otherwise.
EV/HV risk management is in scope on any impact; underbody/sill/battery-zone contact escalates further.
Badge/VIN disagreement, clone/export marker, or prior-category assertion.
Material decides the permitted method; no generic heat/pull/weld assumptions.

impact_zones.description: Corner impact forward of the front wheel, including headlamp corner and wing.
systems_at_risk: suspension arm/strut/hub on the impacted corner
required_evidence: close and context photos of the corner and arch

systems_at_risk: engine ancillaries at the front of the bay

impact_zones.description: Side impact at door height, away from pillars.
required_evidence: close and context photos of each affected door

impact_zones.description: Side impact into the sill, B-pillar, or floor edge.
systems_at_risk: underfloor lines and (on EVs) battery edge
boot floor and chassis rail end
rear suspension on the impacted corner
fuel filler area on that side
rear body panel and lamp carriers

impact_zones.description: Wheel/kerb strike or pothole impact without significant panel contact.
systems_at_risk: ball joints/bushes/track rod on that corner
required_evidence: wheel and tyre close-ups (tread and sidewall)

impact_zones.description: Grounding, debris strike, or ramp/kerb underside contact.
required_evidence: on EVs: battery-case inspection under manufacturer procedure

impact_zones.description: Roof contact, rollover, or falling-object impact.
required_evidence: roof and pillar photos all angles

impact_zones.description: Water ingress or flood exposure, any depth.
Fire or significant heat exposure, however localised.
systems_at_risk: wiring looms beyond the visible burn
structural heat effect on HSS/UHSS and aluminium
required_evidence: photos of burn extent and adjacent zones
on EVs: thermal-event history and quarantine status

impact_zones.description: Any impact, grounding, or exposure with plausible reach into BEV/PHEV battery, HV cabling, or charging components.
